dict.string: WeCord uses your location to send it to a chat, and to share it live for as long as you choose. Sharing pauses when WeCord is closed.
WeCord uses your location to send it to a chat, and to share it live for as long as you choose. Sharing pauses when WeCord is closed.
WeCord uses the microphone to record voice messages, to talk in voice channels, to type what you say and to make captions of what you say in a call.

WeCord uses speech recognition to turn a voice message into text, to type what you say when you ask it to, and to make captions of what you say in a call when captions are on and you share yours. It runs on your Mac whenever it can. Only the text is shared with the call, never your voice.
WeCord uses the camera for video in voice channels, to scan QR codes and to take photos and videos for your daily.
